_comment: Console folder name (as used under the Emulation/ R2 prefix, e.g. Emulation/NES/) -> EmulatorJS EJS_core identifier. Add a ROM by dropping it into Emulation/<ConsoleName>/ using one of the console names below -- /api/emulation looks up the matching core from this file automatically. See https://emulatorjs.org/docs/systems/ for the authoritative core list.
